# Wrexer

> High-performance application hosting on bare metal Kubernetes. Deploy apps & PostgreSQL in seconds without cloud complexity. A faster, more affordable alternative to Vercel, Railway, and Render.

## Key Links

- [Homepage](https://wrexer.com): Explore our platform's features and core offerings.
- [Documentation](https://github.com/wrexer): Detailed technical guides, API references, and open-source resources.
- [Pricing](https://wrexer.com/#plans): Transparent, pay-per-hour billing starting at ₹149/month.
- [Contact Us](https://wrexer.com/contact): Get support directly from the founder.

## Core Features

- **Instant App Deployment**: Deploy Node.js, Python, or Go apps in seconds with optimized container orchestration.
- **Managed PostgreSQL**: Production-grade PostgreSQL 16 instances with one-click provisioning and high availability.
- **Persistent Storage**: NVMe-backed Persistent Volume Claims (PVC) ensure your data survives crashes and restarts.
- **Private Networking**: Secure internal Kubernetes DNS for database connectivity; databases are not exposed to the public internet.
- **VM-Level Isolation**: Hardware-virtualized isolation using Kata Containers for security-critical workloads (Coming Soon).
- **Transparent Billing**: Low-cost, pay-as-you-go pricing with no hidden fees. significantly cheaper than traditional cloud providers.

## Pricing Plans

### Application Hosting
- **Tiny**: Free (100m CPU, 128Mi RAM) - Hobbies & Testing.
- **Small**: ₹0.20/hr (₹149/mo) - 250m CPU, 256Mi RAM.
- **Basic**: ₹0.39/hr (₹279/mo) - 500m CPU, 512Mi RAM.
- **Medium**: ₹0.76/hr (₹549/mo) - 1000m (1 vCPU), 1Gi RAM.
- **Large**: ₹1.45/hr (₹1049/mo) - 2000m (2 vCPU), 2Gi RAM.
- **XLarge**: ₹2.75/hr (₹1999/mo) - 4000m (4 vCPU), 4Gi RAM.

### Managed Databases (PostgreSQL 16)
- **DB Small**: ₹0.62/hr (₹449/mo) - 500m CPU, 1Gi RAM, 5Gi SSD.
- **DB Medium**: ₹1.10/hr (₹799/mo) - 1000m CPU, 2Gi RAM, 10Gi SSD.
- **DB Large**: ₹2.10/hr (₹1499/mo) - 2000m CPU, 4Gi RAM, 20Gi SSD.

### Secure Containers (Kata VM-level Isolation) - Coming Soon
- **Kata Small**: ₹0.34/hr (₹249/mo) - 250m CPU, 256Mi RAM.
- **Kata Medium**: ₹1.04/hr (₹749/mo) - 1000m CPU, 1Gi RAM.
- **Kata Large**: ₹2.08/hr (₹1499/mo) - 2000m CPU, 2Gi RAM.
